description: English (en-US) wording: standard device phrases and title conventions for the prompt, the labels of the recipe as the converter reads it, and the words the plausibility checks look for in step texts. Hand-written from the most frequent text steps of the en-US corpus (see corpus below); not verified on a device. List entries match anywhere inside a word, case-insensitively; a leading ^ makes an entry match only at the start of a word, a trailing $ only at its end.

standardPhrases.measuringCupOut: Remove the measuring beaker from the lid.
standardPhrases.measuringCupIn: Insert the measuring beaker into the lid.
standardPhrases.pushDown: Use the spatula to scrape down the inside of the blender jug.
standardPhrases.whiskIn: Insert the mixer attachment into the blender jug.
standardPhrases.basketIn: Insert the cooking pot into the blender jug.
standardPhrases.basketSplashGuard: Put the cooking pot on the lid as a splash guard.
standardPhrases.steamerSpread: spread out in the steamer basket
standardPhrases.steamerOn: Attach the steamer basket to the blender jug.
standardPhrases.throughLid: through the opening in the lid
standardPhrases.weighInContainer: Place a bowl on the blender jug and weigh 50 g milk into it.
standardPhrases.returnReserved: Put 200 g reserved vegetable stock into the blender jug.
standardPhrases.oilOntoLid: Pour the oil slowly onto the lid so that it runs down the measuring beaker into the blender jug.

stepTitleRules.turboTitle: Hold down the turbo button for 2 seconds.
stepTitleRules.scaleDescription: Put <n> g <ingredient> into the blender jug.
